sections.Problem: Node drains during cluster upgrades drop requests even when every workload has a PodDisruptionBudget.
sections.Contribution: A walkthrough of one drain from cordon to the last eviction, with the budget, probe, and preStop settings that keep traffic flowing.
sections.Takeaways: Size budgets for real replica counts, pair them with readiness probes and preStop hooks, and test a drain before the next upgrade.
sections.What is new: Managed platforms now upgrade nodes on a fixed schedule, so drains happen without an operator watching.
sections.Story notes: Fictional example talk for the cfp guide.
